Four lines do not, and each is accounted for: «Behi 👌» twice (the opening of @name-phone, standing in for a turn that has no approved line — see gaps), the «Write like this» line of brain/patisserie-nour.md (it is in the brain file but outside an @id block, so lib/lines.js does not see it), and one catalogue price row from data/patisserie-nour.json. These answers must score at or near 9 on every deterministic dimension. If they do not, the checks are wrong, not the answers.
